constraint_prompts.prompt: Fog covers the seas and hugs the tree-covered hills, floating through the morning as it exhales its introduction. This world is at peace. In the awakening of dawn, in fresh muted colors: we can rebuild this temple. It We can rebuild this temple — under vibrant sun rays of glory, of the wisdoms of morning dews and their winks of luck. With laps around infinity pools of edgeless dreams, that reflect the enormity of the skies. And of modern faiths — that we too can walk on water. Deep breaths, in appreciation of present life, and our present positions. We can rebuild this temple. It
